quarterly_data.signal: IPO prospectus: Eikon's development programs are EIK1001, EIK1003, EIK1004, EIK1005, EIK1006 and an ARv7 program. It relies on license, collaboration and similar agreements for the rights to the core intellectual property of most of its current product candidates, including its most advanced candidate EIK1001, and these agreements impose significant milestone payments and other obligations. The prospectus names continued investment in its technology platform, including its proprietary single molecule tracking (SMT) system, and its drug discovery efforts to identify novel targets and drug candidates among its future capital needs.
